cc:Work.dc:title: Brass Birmingham — self-play PL strength
cc:Work.dc:description: Common-fit PL progression through generation 250: 25 displayed points from 25 checkpoints (cap 30). All displayed checkpoints are exact. Recent detail covers generations 50–250: all 21 points exact, with a separate y-axis. Unmodified pointwise 95% setup-bootstrap intervals. Latest 752.077, interval [687.145, 826.534]. Paired change versus generation 240: 38.014, 95% interval [-22.917, 81.770]. Latest slot: 128 games / 32 setups; Common fit: 3,200 games; 25 rated checkpoints. IL anchor 0; v4 reference 170.468.
